title: How to choose a Shopify theme — what to look for | UTD
description:
Don't choose a Shopify theme on looks alone. Flexible sections, smart product layouts, swatches and sizes, a cart that opens without leaving the page — and mobile, where most of your customers browse first.

Shown on real UTD theme demos: Fuse (footwear, bags, clothing), Impression (dresses, accessories), Victory (food & drinks), Ultra (auto parts, electronics), Boutique (furniture).

7 themes · 35 ready-made designs · different styles and price points, from $100. Try any theme free, as long as you need — you pay only when you publish your store.
👉 https://themes.shopify.com/themes?q=utd
